lead.event: Bank Indonesia raises the BI Rate to 6% and markets respond
lead.headline: Bank Indonesia raises BI Rate to 6% as rupiah firms
lead.blurb: After raising its benchmark rate by 25 basis points, Bank Indonesia increased DNDF hedging incentives to 45% for six-month tenors and 50% for 12-month tenors. The move ended a four-month hold at 5.75%; BI also raised its Deposit Facility rate to 5.25% and Lending Facility rate to 6.75%. Governor Destry Damayanti said the hike was intended to stabilize the rupiah and keep inflation on target. The December BI Board of Governors meeting will help determine whether the hiking cycle is over.
lead.copy_decision: rewritten: regrouped, 3 of its articles moved out

market_structure_policy.event: Bank Indonesia reserve-requirement cuts and deposit-facility changes support bank liquidity
market_structure_policy.headline: Bank Indonesia cuts reserve requirements by 2 points, adding Rp89.9 trillion in liquidity
market_structure_policy.blurb: The cuts take conventional banks’ ratio from 9% to 7% and Islamic banks’ from 7.5% to 5.5%, while the Deposit Facility rate rises 25 bps to 5.25%. The liquidity cushion supports selective bank credit growth through end-2026.

earnings_guidance.event: XLSMART reports nine-month 2026 results and raises its synergy target
earnings_guidance.headline: EXCL reports nine-month results and raises 2026 gross synergy target above US$300 million
earnings_guidance.blurb: XLSMART's revenue grew about 17% year on year in the nine months to 30 September, while normalized EBITDA rose 12% to Rp16.42 trillion and normalized net profit climbed 94% to Rp3.59 trillion. Cumulative gross synergy realization reached US$294 million, with 96% of planned network locations integrated.

earnings_guidance.event: ACES raises its 2026 AZKO store-opening target and receives an updated broker target price
earnings_guidance.headline: ACES raises 2026 AZKO opening target to 40-45 stores
earnings_guidance.blurb: BRI Danareksa raised its target price to Rp520 from Rp470 and maintained its buy rating. Aspirasi Hidup plans to use the expansion to support sales growth through 2027 and kept its target of 40-50 new Neka stores.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 1 new articles with a new fact: BRI Danareksa raised its ACES target price to Rp520 from Rp470.

earnings_guidance.event: HM Sampoerna reports nine-month sales and market share
earnings_guidance.headline: HMSP reports Rp87.5 trillion nine-month sales and 30.0% market share
earnings_guidance.blurb: Sampoerna's net sales rose 4.5% year on year, supported by the government's decision not to raise tobacco excise tariffs in 2026. It sold 60.4 billion sticks despite industry pressures from downtrading and illegal cigarettes.

earnings_guidance.event: KB Valbury raises its Antam target price and projects a high dividend payout
earnings_guidance.headline: KB Valbury raises ANTM target price, projects dividend payout above 80%
earnings_guidance.blurb: KB Valbury projects Antam’s dividend payout ratio above 80% and sees 54% potential stock profit, citing strong net cash, profit growth and possible capacity gains from Mempawah. It revised its 2026 forecasts to Rp113 trillion in revenue and Rp11.8 trillion in net profit.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Medco issues US$300 million notes to refinance debt
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MEDC issues US$300 million notes to refinance debt
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Medco issued the notes on 17 November at 8.875%, with maturity in 2032. Net proceeds will fund tenders, repurchases, refinancing or repayment of existing debt, including notes due 2028, and replace an undrawn committed facility.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: MBMA plans a private placement of up to 10.79 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: MBMA plans placement of up to 10.79 billion shares
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Merdeka Battery Materials says existing shareholders could face dilution of up to 9.09% if all shares are issued. The new shares would equal 10% of paid-up capital, with an issue price of at least 90% of the average closing price over 25 consecutive trading days. Independent shareholders will vote on the plan on 8 December.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: Cipta Perdana Lancar seeks approval for a rights issue
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: PART seeks approval for rights issue targeting Rp200 billion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Cipta Perdana Lancar plans to issue up to 1 billion new shares, with proceeds earmarked for working capital. Shareholders who do not exercise their rights face estimated dilution of 25.97%, and the plan goes to a shareholder meeting on 9 December.

deals_control.event: TGRA proposes a 21 billion-share private placement
deals_control.headline: TGRA proposes 21 billion-share placement, with AMS to take control via 15 billion shares
deals_control.blurb: Terregra Asia Energy plans to issue the shares at Rp10 each for up to Rp210 billion. Adidaya Mandiri Sejahtera will subscribe for 15 billion shares and become the new controlling shareholder after completion, subject to shareholder approval at an extraordinary meeting on 28 December.

deals_control.event: AKRA subsidiary APR agrees to acquire VIVO fuel-station businesses
deals_control.headline: AKRA subsidiary APR agrees to acquire 90% of VIVO fuel-station operator
deals_control.blurb: AKR Corporindo subsidiary APR signed the agreement on 18 November with Vivo Energi Indonesia, which operates SPBU VIVO. Petro Palma Persada will retain 10% after completion, while 47 stations in Jabodetabek and Bandung are planned to join the BP-AKR network through phased rebranding and operations from 2027.

other.event: MNC Sky Vision faces PKPU and prepares debt restructuring
other.headline: MSKY enters temporary PKPU over Ascot's US$4 million claim
other.blurb: At 30 September, MNC Sky Vision had Rp2.11 billion in cash against Rp490.52 billion in short-term liabilities. The court granted Ascot Group Holdings' petition on 5 November, opening a 43-day period through 17 December. The company is negotiating a staged repayment plan funded by operating results.
